name: SKHY-A7: Compact Acoustic Sentinel
description:
The lightweight standard for autonomous aerial & ground detection.

The SKHY-7 is our compact powerhouse. Designed for versatility, it integrates a 7-MEMS microphone array within a precision-machined aluminum housing. It is ideal for mounting on mid-sized drones or ground vehicles where weight is a critical factor without compromising on detection range and get directional heading of objects to be detected.

**Key Features**
- Passive Detection: Completely silent operation; does not emit signals, making it undetectable to targets.
- Edge Compute Ready: Designed to interface directly with edge AI computers for real-time classification.
- Robust Build: 85mm aluminum shielding reduces interference and protects sensitive MEMS components.

**Technical Specifications**
Sensor Array: 7x MEMS Microphones
Detection Range (Autonomous Drones): Up to 2.5 km
Detection Range (Helicopters): upto 20km
Detection Range (Jet Planes, Pre-burn/Take-off): Up to 150 km
Dimensions: 90mm (L) x 90mm (W) x 70mm (H)
Construction: 85mm Diameter Aluminum Housing, Industrial 3D Printed Base
Power Consumption (Driver Board): 5V @ 200mA
Power Consumption (Edge Computer): 5V @ 2A–4A
Estimated Weight: ~240g

name: 2.4/5.2/5.8GHz Triband 20W Outdoor Wireless Signal Booster for WiFi, IoT & Long-Range Communication ROC-6
description: The ACASOM ROC-6 represents the pinnacle of outdoor wireless signal amplification technology, delivering professional-grade performance for long-range WiFi coverage, industrial IoT connectivity, HD video surveillance backhaul, and remote communication systems. This tri-band powerhouse operates simultaneously across 2.4GHz (WiFi & control data), 5.2GHz & 5.8GHz (high-throughput video/data) frequencies, ensuring broad compatibility with standard 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax devices, IP cameras, wireless bridges, and private mesh networks. With an industry-leading 20W (43dBm) output power per band and a high-capacity 5000mAh/16.8V battery, the ROC-6 provides up to 6 hours of continuous operation, dramatically extending your wireless range and overcoming signal obstacles in urban, mountainous, or heavy-interference environments. Key Advantages for Field Professionals Tri-Band Simultaneous Operation: Seamlessly switch between frequencies for uninterrupted data links and crystal-clear HD video streaming. IP68 Rugged Aluminum Housing: Fully waterproof and dustproof—built for all-weather outdoor deployments in the field. Advanced Thermal Management: Guarantees stable performance in extreme conditions (-30°C to +70°C). Dual N-Female RF Ports: Supports high-gain directional antennas for maximum signal focus and penetration over long distances. LCD Power Monitoring & Fast Charging: Real-time battery management with an industrial-grade charging interface. Performance Benefits for Remote Communication & IoT Applications 40% Greater Range: Compared to standard 10W boosters—perfect for long-range wireless backhaul, outdoor hotspot extension, and remote sensor data collection. Superior Signal Penetration: Maintains strong links through buildings, trees, and other obstacles. <1μs Switching Speed: Enables real-time, zero-latency response critical for industrial automation, remote telemetry control, and time-sensitive IoT tasks. Optimized for HD Video Systems: Ensures flawless performance for HD video streaming, wireless HDMI extenders, and point-to-point video surveillance links.
